command: set -euo pipefail; echo '===IDENTITY==='; hostname; id -un; date -Is; echo '===LOCAL_LLM==='; for x in ollama llama-server llama-cli mistral; do printf '%s=' "$x"; command -v "$x" || true; done; if command -v ollama >/dev/null 2>&1; then ollama list 2>/dev/null || true; fi; echo '===DURABLE_DB==='; if [ -f /var/lib/entityos/data/unified.db ]; then stat -c '%n|%s|%y' /var/lib/entityos/data/unified.db; sqlite3 -readonly /var/lib/entityos/data/unified.db "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name;" 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,160p' || true; else echo DURABLE_UNIFIED_MISSING_OR_UNREADABLE; fi; echo '===DB_CANDIDATES_HOME==='; find /home/andreas -xdev -type f \( -name 'unified.db' -o -name 'consciousness.db' -o -name 'amygdala.db' -o -name 'world_experience.db' \) -printf '%p|%s|%TY-%Tm-%TdT%TH:%TM:%TS\n' 2>/dev/null | sort; echo '===VOLATILE_DB_METADATA_ONLY==='; for p in /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/consciousness.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/amygdala.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db; do if [ -e "$p" ]; then stat -c '%n|%s|%y' "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo "PRESENT_UNREADABLE=$p"; else echo "ABSENT=$p"; fi; done; echo '===REPOS==='; find /home/andreas -xdev -maxdepth 5 -type d -name .git -print 2>/dev/null | sed 's#/.git$##' | sort | head -200 | while read -r r; do printf '%s|' "$r"; git -C "$r" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo NOHEAD; done; echo PREFLIGHT_DONE=1
